Technical SEO.title: Google September 2026 Spam Update Has Been Unleashed
Technical SEO.summary: Google has released a global September 2026 spam update expected to take a couple of weeks to roll out, impacting all languages and targeting sites engaged in spam.

Technical SEO.title: Multimodal Search Type Filter In Google Search Console Performance Report
Technical SEO.summary: Google is rolling out a new Search Console performance report filter that splits Web search type into Text-based and Multimodal, enabling SEOs to separately analyze traffic from image-based searches.

Technical SEO.title: Google Search Ranking Volatility Hits September 23rd and 24th
Technical SEO.summary: Significant unconfirmed Google Search ranking volatility was observed starting around September 22nd-23rd, with community chatter reflecting broader concerns about declining organic traffic signals.

Technical SEO.title: WTF is NLWeb? - Whiteboard Friday
Technical SEO.summary: Crystal Carter explains NLWeb, covering how the Natural Language Web uses the ASK protocol and structured data to prepare sites for the agentic web.

Technical SEO.title: Google Video Schema Gets Creator Property and Updated interactionStatistic
Technical SEO.summary: Google has updated its VideoObject structured data documentation to add support for the creator and author properties and to clarify supported interaction types for interactionStatistic, relevant for any enterprise site using video schema.

Technical SEO.title: Google Tests AI Overviews On Hotel On Side Panel
Technical SEO.summary: Google is testing placement of AI Overviews in the bottom-right side panel of hotel knowledge panels rather than at the top of search results, a format shift directly relevant to travel and hospitality SEO.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Search Decline Steepened To 40% YoY For Publishers
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A report finds that Google Search and Discover traffic declines for publishers have steepened year-over-year, while direct, internal, and dark social traffic grew, signaling a structural shift in referral channels.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Search Console Uses Block Flattening For AIOs, Forget Position and Focus On Outcomes
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Block flattening in Search Console can make weak AI Overview visibility appear as a top ranking position, so the recommendation is to measure actual visits and conversions rather than position to assess true search performance.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Announces New Query Fan-Out Framework: R4T-Diffusion
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google has announced a new query fan-out framework called R4T-Diffusion, described as ready for production-scale search, indicating continued infrastructure evolution for how queries are processed and expanded.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: B2B Brands Turn to Creator Video to Fight AI Slop and Aid AI Search
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Creator video is emerging as a content strategy for B2B brands seeking to differentiate from AI-generated content and improve visibility in AI search surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Rolls Out September 2026 Spam Update Globally
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google confirmed the September 2026 spam update is rolling out worldwide and may take up to two weeks to complete, making it a priority monitoring item for enterprise SEO teams.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Search Console Adds Multimodal Filter For Image-Based Searches
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Console's new multimodal filter allows SEOs to identify which pages receive traffic from image-based searches, though query-level data is not included in this view.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLMs Are Time Machines That Don't Tell You How Far You Went
AI Search / GEO.summary: AI answers strip out the temporal and contextual signals users previously relied on to evaluate information, creating gaps in content strategy that affect visibility on both current and legacy AI answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Generative Engine Optimization Emerges as the Holiday Season's Fastest-Growing Service
AI Search / GEO.summary: A press release dated September 21, 2026 identifies generative engine optimization as the fastest-growing service heading into the holiday season, reflecting accelerating enterprise demand for GEO alongside traditional SEO.
